name: Bolgan's Hole
summary: In southern Desolace, the Gelkis keep their power and sacred crystals within Bolgan's Hole. Their khan and shamans guard the cavern.

sections.title: The Gelkis Seat of Power
sections.body: Above the Gelkis encampment, the khan holds court in a cavern cut into the bluffs. Veteran guards and influential shamans gather around their ruler. The cliffs defend the clan from its rivals, especially the Magram centaur to the east.

sections.title: Tears of the Earth Princess
sections.body: Blue crystals gleam in the damp stone walls of Bolgan's Hole. The Gelkis call them the tears of Theradras and honor them as sacred blessings. Their shamans harvest and guard the crystals. They believe the stones bring protection from Princess Theradras, the primal earth elemental mother of the centaur race.

faq.answer: Bolgan's Hole lies in the southern cliffs of Gelkis Village, in southern Desolace.
The cavern shelters the Gelkis clan's high leaders, including its khan, along with their protectors and shamans.

faq.q: What are the glowing blue crystals inside the cave?
faq.answer: The glowing blue crystals are called the tears of Theradras. The Gelkis revere them as signs of their earth mother's favor and believe they protect whoever possesses them.

faq.q: Can players enter Bolgan's Hole safely?
aliases: can i go inside bolgans hole
faq.answer: The Gelkis centaur inside are hostile to outsiders. Travelers who slaughter the Gelkis' hated rivals, the Magram clan, can earn enough standing to walk through the cavern in peace.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see how the Gelkis bind their worship of earth to Princess Theradras and the centaur race's violent legacy.
